outcome-l1-forward-contracts-explain.action: Identify the terms and both obligations of a forward, assign long and short sides, and explain the benefit direction.
outcome-l1-forward-contracts-explain.conditions: Given a dated one-unit purchase or sale with an agreed delivery price; explain before consulting the answer.
outcome-l1-forward-contracts-explain.successCriterion: Correctly identify asset, quantity, delivery date and price, both parties and obligations; explain why the long benefits when maturity spot exceeds delivery price and why a losing party cannot simply decline performance.

outcome-l1-forward-contracts-apply.action: Construct both exchange legs, calculate signed per-unit and total maturity payoffs, and distinguish payoff from payment and total profit.
outcome-l1-forward-contracts-apply.conditions: Given delivery price, maturity spot and positive quantity in matching currency and asset units; assume performance and no extra costs, and explicitly state further profit conditions.
outcome-l1-forward-contracts-apply.successCriterion: Show both asset and cash legs, calculate both payoffs to the penny, check equal-and-opposite totals and zero payoff at equal prices despite delivery, and explain the zero-initial-value/no-upfront-payment and no-extra-costs conditions for payoff to equal position profit.

outcome-l1-purpose-and-contracts-explain.action: Identify derivative underlyings and contract terms, name four derivative families, and distinguish future payoff from today’s price and a mutual obligation from an option right.
outcome-l1-purpose-and-contracts-explain.conditions: Given the three source examples and a new explicit trigger, without assuming missing contract terms or a valuation model.
outcome-l1-purpose-and-contracts-explain.successCriterion: Identify the underlying and needed terms for each example; apply strict trigger/equality correctly; name forwards, futures, swaps and options; explain why a possible future payment is not its current price.

outcome-l1-purpose-and-contracts-apply.action: Calculate a currency purchase exposure, compare the four stated choices, and classify hedging, speculation and arbitrage by exposure and strategy.
outcome-l1-purpose-and-contracts-apply.conditions: Conditional on the source scenario’s fixed $10 million bill, with a pounds-per-dollar quote and no fees/financing for cost arithmetic; preserve the conflicting £10 million title.
outcome-l1-purpose-and-contracts-apply.successCriterion: Calculate pound cost and changes exactly with correct units; retain the currency conflict; explain all four choices without a universal best claim; correctly justify all three purpose classes and arbitrage feasibility conditions.

outcome-l1-markets-and-clearing-explain.action: Compare source exchange/OTC features, justify a market choice for unusual terms, and explain conditional default transmission through a bilateral network.
outcome-l1-markets-and-clearing-explain.conditions: Given a market-choice scenario and a chain of private obligations, distinguishing trading arrangement from clearing.
outcome-l1-markets-and-clearing-explain.successCriterion: Retain all four features for each market and their qualifiers; distinguish liquidity, transparency and default risk; explain a customization trade-off and how limited visibility can hide a possible, not inevitable, propagation channel.

outcome-l1-markets-and-clearing-apply.action: Trace CCP interposition and a toy settlement obligation, and match the four qualified reform measures to information, default-management and trading problems.
outcome-l1-markets-and-clearing-apply.conditions: Given A’s sale/B’s purchase and a same-time pound obligation with stated immediately available collateral; use the course’s historical account, not a current legal determination.
outcome-l1-markets-and-clearing-apply.successCriterion: Name CCP buyer-to-seller and seller-to-buyer roles, compute scheduled net cash and conditional uncovered amounts exactly, distinguish them from final loss, correctly match all four measures and retain contract/counterparty/jurisdiction qualifiers and residual risk.

outcome-l1-market-charts-and-positions-e.action: Read both historical derivative-turnover chart panels, their different axes and provenance, and answer the three source evidence questions with appropriate limits.
outcome-l1-market-charts-and-positions-e.conditions: Using the original page-17 chart, its full accessible transcription and a separately labelled hypothetical two-axis example; do not digitise exact observations or infer current/future volumes.
outcome-l1-market-charts-and-positions-e.successCriterion: Identify measure, currency/time units, year ticks, series/axes and approximate patterns; distinguish observation frequencies and interpolation; compute hypothetical difference/ratio correctly; state historical OTC FX dominance without treating turnover as money at risk or interpolated paths as measured monthly data.

outcome-l1-market-charts-and-positions-a.action: Classify source and new positions by existing exposure or matched price inconsistency, and test a hypothetical executable price gap after costs.
outcome-l1-market-charts-and-positions-a.conditions: Given the source’s explicitly attributed three classifications plus new exposure/strategy descriptions and a same-time identical-claim buy/sell example.
outcome-l1-market-charts-and-positions-a.successCriterion: Justify hedging/speculation/arbitrage without relying only on product name or later profit; identify hedge limits; calculate after-fee gain to the penny; state equivalence, execution, funding, timing and cost assumptions before claiming a locked-in gain.

outcome-l1-currency-forwards-explain.action: Select dealer quotes and long/short GBP hedge directions; explain exposure, timing and source currency-label error.
outcome-l1-currency-forwards-explain.conditions: Given the complete p23 USD/GBP bid/offer table and a GBP payable or receivable.
outcome-l1-currency-forwards-explain.successCriterion: Correctly identify quote units, maturity, customer/dealer sides, adverse FX move and fixed future cost/receipt; distinguish certainty from guaranteed profit and preserve the p24 printed-dollar caveat.

outcome-l1-currency-forwards-apply.action: Calculate and interpret conversions, both forward payoffs and combined hedged cost/receipt.
outcome-l1-currency-forwards-apply.conditions: Given positive GBP quantity, matching-date USD/GBP rates and explicit no-cost/performance/physical-delivery conventions.
outcome-l1-currency-forwards-apply.successCriterion: Show unit cancellation, intermediate signed arithmetic and zero checks; monetary accuracy 0.01 USD; distinguish physical transfers from value payoff, diagnose reversed hedge direction and give a matched teach-back.

outcome-l1-forward-payoff-graphs-explain.action: Describe both original forward diagrams, payoff geometry and the Profit-axis caveat.

outcome-l1-forward-payoff-graphs-explain.successCriterion: Name exact axes, absent scale/units, fixed K, signs, zero crossing, reflection and zero-sum limits; state zero-initial-value/no-premium and no additional financing/transaction-cost assumptions before equating payoff with profit.

outcome-l1-forward-payoff-graphs-apply.action: Compute and plot both payoff lines, scale quantity, calculate slopes and qualify bounds.
outcome-l1-forward-payoff-graphs-apply.conditions: Given GBP/unit delivery and maturity prices, positive quantity and an explicitly stated asset price domain.
outcome-l1-forward-payoff-graphs-apply.successCriterion: Give at least three correct long/short coordinates, matching units, slopes and zero crossing; verify zero-sum to 0.01 GBP; explain physical transfers, reject clipped losses and unjustified nonnegative commodity-price assumptions.

outcome-l1-margin-and-contract-size-expl.successCriterion: Identify definitions, underlying/size/month/price units/direction, unknown source thresholds/targets and strict equality boundary; distinguish deposits, trading losses and notionals with a matched teach-back.

outcome-l1-calls-and-puts-apply.successCriterion: Complete every source table independently, justify below/equal/above cases, keep full difference inside max and writer sign outside, compute totals within 0.01 GBP and explain actual transfers and negative profit despite nonnegative holder payoff.
